_comment: This file lists VFS asset paths that are loaded directly by C++ engine code
with no corresponding reference in XML templates, actor files, or other data
Each entry is a VFS path (relative to the mod root, without the mod/ prefix).
checkrefs.py treats every listed path as a known-used file so that files
providing these paths in any mod layer (including mod overrides) are not
Keep this list in sync with the C++ source files noted in each entry's comment.
Pattern-based paths (e.g. animated water frames with printf format strings)
are handled separately inside checkrefs.py itself.
